name: diagonal-hatch
title: Diagonal Hatch
description: Fine diagonal hatching that fades towards the edges, like a sketch shaded with a ruler.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Distance between hatch lines, in pixels.

props.name: angle
props.description: Direction of the lines in degrees.

props.name: strength
props.description: Line strength as a percentage of the foreground color.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fades the hatch out towards the edges.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the layer. Place it absolutely behind your content.
